# Wrap & Wing Co.

> Bold Flavour. Hot & Fresh. Flame-Grilled Chicken, Handcrafted Wraps, and Charred Wings in Pinetown, Durban.

## About Us
Wrap & Wing Co. is a fast-casual restaurant and takeaway based in Pinetown, Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. We specialize in flame-grilled chicken, fresh toasted wraps, seasoned wings basted in 5 signature sauces, hearty burgers, and crispy sides.

- **Website**: https://wrapandwings.co.za/
- **Location**: Shop 1, Uniland Centre, Pinetown, Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, 3610, South Africa
- **Landmark**: Behind Hollywoodbets, Uniland Centre
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +27 68 886 3892 (068 886 3892)
- **Email (General Inquiries)**: info@wrapandwings.co.za
- **Email (Orders & Payments)**: orders@wrapandwings.co.za
- **Trading Hours**: Monday – Sunday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Open 7 days a week)
- **Service Options**: Dine-in, Takeaway collection, Local delivery
- **Google Maps**: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Wrap+and+Wing+Co/@-29.8120098,30.8555607,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x1ef6ff609bbeefc7:0xb1b982704527f3d7!8m2!3d-29.8120098!4d30.8555607!16s%2Fg%2F11nvh9v3d5

## 5 Signature Basting Flavours
1. **Lemony (Mild)**: Fresh lemon and herb infusion with a zesty citrus kick.
2. **Mild**: Gentle savoury warmth with slow-roasted spices.
3. **Barbeque (BBQ)**: Sweet, smoky, and sticky flame-grilled classic.
4. **Sweet Chilli**: Sweet golden honey undertones balanced with a spicy kick.
5. **Hot**: Authentic fiery peri-peri heat for genuine spice lovers.

## Menu Categories & Offerings
- **Flame-Grilled Wings**: 6 Wings, 12 Wings, 24 Wings, and Wing Combos basted in any of our 5 signature sauces.
- **Handcrafted Wraps**: Flame-grilled chicken breast, crisp lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and house sauces wrapped in fresh toasted flatbread.
- **Flame-Grilled Chicken**: Quarter chicken, half chicken, full chicken, and family feast meals served with spicy rice, chips, or coleslaw.
- **Burgers & Rolls**: Succulent chicken fillet burgers (grilled or crispy fried) served with golden chips.
- **Toasted Sandwiches**: Classic golden toasted sandwiches served with small chips or salad.
- **Seafood**: Crispy battered fish fillet served with chips and tartar sauce.
- **Sides**: Seasoned hot chips, fragrant spicy rice, and creamy coleslaw.

## How to Order Online
Customers can order directly on the website:
1. Visit https://wrapandwings.co.za/
2. Select your items, pick your flavour basting (Lemony, Mild, BBQ, Sweet Chilli, Hot), and add to cart.
3. Choose Collection (pickup at Shop 1, Uniland Centre, Pinetown) or Local Delivery.
4. Pay securely online via PayFast (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, or Instant EFT) or choose Cash on Collection.
5. Track your order live on screen or receive instant WhatsApp updates.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Where are you located?** Shop 1, Uniland Centre, Pinetown (behind Hollywoodbets), Durban, KZN.
- **What time do you open and close?** Open 7 days a week, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM every Monday through Sunday.
- **Do you deliver?** Yes, we offer local delivery across the Pinetown area as well as quick in-store collection.
- **What payment methods do you accept?** Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Instant EFT (via PayFast), as well as cash on collection.
